split: First192 hash-sorted historical train documents discovery; remaining64 pilot confirmation. No original BSF validation/test document selected. Documents reused, not new corpus or model pretraining holdout.
design: Capture MLP12 writes at four predetermined causal prefix positions per document, plus native next-token diagnostics. Freeze task-trained PCA128; inspect its orthogonal residual. Fit8 spherical residual clusters using discovery only, two seeds,50steps. Save examples for hypothesis generation; no causal or task-discovery claim.
limits: Residual Euclidean geometry and prototype clusters may reflect token/format/topic confounds. Native next tokens are contextual continuations, not supervised task labels. No cluster outcome-based selection.
